title: Why I'm Here
description: The first episode. Why I'm starting this podcast, what broke, and what I'm trying to rebuild. No polish, no pretense — just the truth about where I am and where I want to go.
showNotes:
In this debut episode, I lay it all out — who I am, what happened, and why I felt compelled to hit record. I'm John Sobetsky. On paper, things look fine. But the reality behind the scenes has been a different story.

This podcast isn't about motivational platitudes. It's about what it actually takes to put yourself back together when life falls apart.

**Key Topics:**
- The moment I realized something had to change
- Why vulnerability is the hardest skill to learn as a man
- What "rebuilding" actually means — it's not a comeback story, it's a daily practice
- What you can expect from this podcast going forward
